desc: Finalize the exact conflict/feasibility condition for signed intervals: conflicts = (1) shared endpoint, (2) same-sign crossing; opposite-sign crossing and opposite-sign containment are NOT conflicts (verified via sample 2 query 3 and explicit potential assignment).
Verify condition on samples: S1Q1 Yes, S1Q2 No, S2Q1 No, S2Q2 Yes, S2Q3 Yes.
Design two-pointer sweep with segment trees for same-sign crossing + shared-endpoint detection, O(M log N).
Monotonicity f(L+1)>=f(L); answer Yes iff R<=f(L).
Fix `conflict()`: remove opposite-sign containment queries; clean up dead code (`seg_update`, stray no-op in `remove`); re-verify samples mentally.

Rigorously prove sufficiency of the two-pattern condition (shortest directed cycle in component DAG forces shared endpoint or same-sign crossing) and stress-test final implementation against brute-force Bellman-Ford feasibility checker on small random cases — all matched.
